research_questions.exchange: How much transport of Agulhas Current origin crosses the GoodHope section within four years?
research_questions.retention: How much crosses GoodHope an odd number of times and therefore remains in the South Atlantic at experiment end?
research_questions.transformation: How do transport-weighted temperature, salinity, and density classes change between release and GoodHope crossing?
research_questions.heat: What reference-relative advective heat signal accompanies qualified transport, under separately declared temperature and reference conventions?

release.primary_section: full width and depth of southward Agulhas Current at 32S
release.cadence: every five days for one complete release year
release.weighting: particle count and individual weight derived from southward native-cell volume transport at each release

advection.saved_cadence: daily particle position, potential temperature, and salinity
advection.crossing_log: ordered timestamp and direction for every GoodHope crossing; do not store terminal fate only

destination.section: published composite GoodHope exit: archived West and Northwest sections west of the retroflection through the Cape Basin
destination.geometry_status: resolved for replication by CC BY 4.0 GEOMAR Parcels_sections_32S.nc: 53 West and 2 Northwest coordinate records; a new run must map these coordinates to its own native grid
destination.exchange_definition: at least one GoodHope crossing within four years
destination.retention_definition: odd number of GoodHope crossings within four years

reference_design.time_reference: release year for annual transport series

dataset_requirements.continuous_span: at least five continuous years for each one-year release cohort
variables: vertical velocity or validated 3-D advection equivalent
dataset_requirements.temporal_resolution: five days or finer for velocity and release weighting
dataset_requirements.mesoscale_requirement: eddy-rich field capable of representing rings, cyclones, filaments, and direct leakage; resolution sensitivity required
dataset_requirements.domain: contains the complete 32S and ACT release sections, retroflection, return-current exit, Cape Basin, and GoodHope section with a buffer

required_outputs.transport: sum native-cell particle volume-transport weights by release year and qualification rule
required_outputs.crossing_parity: all-crossing and odd-crossing estimates reported side by side
required_outputs.section_sensitivity: 32S and ACT release estimates remain separate
required_outputs.transit_time: transport-weighted distribution from release to first GoodHope crossing, retaining the four-year censored tail
required_outputs.thermohaline: transport-weighted theta/S/density classes at release and first GoodHope crossing
required_outputs.heat: optional until density, heat capacity, temperature variable, reference temperature, and crossing-time convention are frozen

acceptance_tests: native release-cell transport sums reproduce the signed Agulhas Current section total
particle weights sum back to every sampled release-section transport within declared tolerance
GoodHope geometry has a pinned source and exact vertices mapped reproducibly to the target native grid
every crossing has direction and time; parity is reproducible from the event log
all-crossing and odd-crossing estimates are both emitted and never silently substituted
32S versus ACT and integration-duration sensitivity are reported before a preferred estimate
temperature-salinity bins sum back to qualified volume transport
heat output passes the reference-temperature identity with matched net volume transport

m2_gap_audit.m2: four surface centers with equal-count neighborhoods
m2_gap_audit.m3: full-width/full-depth native 32S section with transport weights
five-day releases for one year and four-year advection
archived West + Northwest GoodHope composite mapped to target grid
Indian-origin transport with complete crossing event log and parity
temperature, salinity, density classes; heat only under explicit convention

literature_facts_used: Schmidt et al. report transit times from less than one month to several years; the modal interval is about 160–170 days and more than half the transport reaches GoodHope within roughly 280–300 days.
Schmidt et al. find that moving the release from 32S to ACT changes mean leakage transport, while crossing parity also changes the mean.
Schmidt et al. recommend release-year attribution for particles crossing GoodHope within four years; odd crossings are required for an overturning-retention question.
Daher et al. show different surface and intermediate-depth leakage behavior and distinct northward versus northwestward Cape Basin routes.

observational float/drifter leakage, depth dependence, ACT and GoodHope comparison

boundary: This artifact specifies a new experiment and contains no raw M3 velocity or new OSW leakage, volume, heat, or AMOC estimate. The published section geometry and derived INALT20/Parcels outputs are now acquired for attributed replication; a new execution still requires eddy-rich 3-D velocity and target-grid section mapping.
